levers.min_reform_lever: Single interagency board-effectiveness assessment.
levers.overlapping_sources: OCC App. D III.F; SR 21-3; LFI rating

roadmap.instrument: Joint statement; align App. D III.F with SR 21-3

levers.whats_distinct: Minimal.
levers.whats_duplicative: Parallel self-assessment / effectiveness evaluation under Fed and OCC.

levers.min_reform_lever: Cross-reference manual to the rule; avoid restating. v2.1: resolve the two unreconciled pending rewrites (2024 proposals add a freestanding board-oversight standard + annual ratification; 2026 proposals permit approval by the board, an equivalent body, or senior management) before they compound the layering.
levers.overlapping_sources: 31 CFR 1010.210; agency program rules; FFIEC manual; FinCEN reproposal
levers.whats_distinct: Largely one program; overlap is rule-vs-manual elaboration.
levers.whats_duplicative: Board approval/oversight/training/independent-testing duties stated in the rule and elaborated by the FFIEC manual.

levers.min_reform_lever: Coordinate CMS expectations; CFPB now lightly enforced (2026).
levers.overlapping_sources: CFPB manual; OCC/FDIC CMS; SR 08-8
levers.whats_distinct: CFPB consumer mandate vs. prudential safety-and-soundness.
levers.whats_duplicative: CMS board oversight across CFPB and prudential regulators.

levers.min_reform_lever: One interagency real-estate-lending standard; fold ACL/credit-review into the risk-committee credit cycle.
levers.overlapping_sources: Real Estate Lending Standards (parts 208/365/34); ACL policy statement; credit-risk-review guidance; Reg O; Reg W; Reg F
levers.whats_distinct: Insider-credit (Reg O) and affiliate (Reg W) approvals protect the insured bank specifically.
levers.whats_duplicative: Annual real-estate-lending policy approval, ACL oversight, and independent credit review stated in parallel across agency appendices and rules.

levers.min_reform_lever: Consolidate into Reg YY; OCC incorporates by reference.

levers.whats_distinct: Bank-level independence-of-CRE-from-front-line structure is an OCC-specific control.
levers.whats_duplicative: Board approval of the same individual's appointment/pay at two levels.

levers.min_reform_lever: Single interagency change-in-director notice procedure.
levers.whats_distinct: Statutory disqualification and Call Report attestation are unique, low-burden duties.
levers.whats_duplicative: Parallel FRB/OCC change-in-director (914) notice regimes; statutory bars; report attestation.

levers.min_reform_lever: Single cross-referenced prudential independence definition.
levers.overlapping_sources: OCC App. D III.D; Reg YY 252.33(a)(4); FDICIA; SOX 301; DFA 952; exchange listing

roadmap.authority: Multiple (SOX, DFA, FDI Act, exchange oversight)
roadmap.reform: Single 'independent director' definition for banking orgs
roadmap.statutory_obstacle: Cross-regulator (SEC + banking) coordination; differing statutory lineages

levers.whats_distinct: Different lookback periods and affiliation tests reflect different statutory lineages.
levers.whats_duplicative: Six non-uniform independence tests applied to the same directors.

levers.min_reform_lever: One consolidated director-training program covering all topics.
levers.overlapping_sources: OCC App. D III.E; SR 21-3 / Director's Book; BSA program rule
levers.whats_distinct: BSA training is topic-specific.
levers.whats_duplicative: Ongoing director-training obligations from multiple sources, separately documented.

levers.min_reform_lever: Permit the §36/Part 363 audit committee to satisfy the fiduciary-audit duty where composition overlaps.
levers.whats_distinct: Charter-specific trust duties distinct from enterprise risk governance.
levers.whats_duplicative: Board direction of fiduciary activities, written fiduciary policies, and a fiduciary audit committee (most material to BNY, State Street).

levers.min_reform_lever: Finalize one 956 framework or rely on guidance; SEC independence satisfies the prudential element.
levers.overlapping_sources: DFA 956 (unimplemented); 2010 guidance; OCC App. D; DFA 952 / exchange

roadmap.statutory_obstacle: Six-agency joint action; FRB/SEC previously declined

levers.whats_distinct: SEC comp-committee independence serves investors.
levers.whats_duplicative: Comp-governance duties across an unfinished rule, guidance, and SEC independence rules.

levers.min_reform_lever: One enterprise info-security program approval; joint SEC/banking statement on cyber oversight. v2.1: the 36-hour interagency incident-notification rule and the SEC cyber-disclosure regime impose non-aligned timelines on the same incident — harmonization here is selection of a single operational standard, not deletion.
levers.overlapping_sources: GLBA 501(b) (12 CFR 30 App. B + three parallel appendices); SEC Reg S-K 106; incident-notification rule; FFIEC IT
levers.whats_distinct: SEC disclosure serves investors; the prudential program serves safety-and-soundness.
levers.whats_duplicative: Same information-security program approved at BHC and IDI levels under four parallel appendices; cyber oversight also disclosed to the SEC.

levers.min_reform_lever: Coordinate related-party review processes.
levers.overlapping_sources: Reg O (215); Reg W (223); SEC Reg S-K 404
levers.whats_distinct: Reg O/W protect the insured bank; SEC protects investors.
levers.whats_duplicative: Related-party and insider-transaction board review across banking and SEC rules.

levers.min_reform_lever: One board liquidity approval satisfies rule and guidance.
levers.overlapping_sources: Reg YY 252.34; SR 10-6; OCC Liquidity handbook
levers.whats_distinct: IDI-level liquidity matters where the bank funds independently.
levers.whats_duplicative: Liquidity risk-tolerance/strategy approval stated as rule (BHC) and guidance (BHC + IDI).

levers.min_reform_lever: Confirm the Heightened Standards do not re-impose the dropped board duty. v2.1: SR 26-2 and OCC Bulletin 2026-13 (eff. Apr. 17, 2026) are expressly non-prescriptive and non-enforceable — neither should be cited as a binding board-approval mandate; any enforceable duty derives from 12 U.S.C. 1831p-1 / 12 CFR 30 App. D.
levers.overlapping_sources: SR 26-2 (replaced SR 11-7); OCC App. D (residual)
levers.whats_distinct: n/a
levers.whats_duplicative: Largely removed in 2026; residual oversight via the risk-governance framework.

levers.min_reform_lever: Not a consolidation target; documented to show how personal liability compounds the cost of duplicative mandates.
levers.whats_distinct: Runs to the individual director, not the board as a governance body; NOT counted as recurring board actions.
levers.whats_duplicative: Analytically distinct individual-director exposure (criminal, removal, receivership/OLA, indemnification) — amplifies cumulative burden.

levers.min_reform_lever: Single 'resilience planning' board cycle; shared resolution submission with an IDI annex.

levers.whats_duplicative: Multiple board-approved resilience plans on different cycles; parent and IDI resolution submissions overlap heavily.

levers.min_reform_lever: Interagency risk-appetite template + safe harbor that one board-approved statement satisfies all.

levers.whats_duplicative: None; a tension rather than a duplication.
